title: Celastrol attenuates Th17 cell response through downregulating HDAC3/FOXO3/GLS1-dependent glutaminolysis.
authors: Liu, Yan; Zhang, Wenjie; Guo, Yilei; Wei, Zhifeng; Xia, Yufeng; Dai, Yue
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究雷公藤红素通过HDAC3/FOXO3/GLS1通路抑制Th17细胞分化，虽涉及FOXO3与GLS1启动子结合及分子对接，但核心是细胞代谢与免疫调控，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Preparations of Tripterygium wilfordii have long been used in China for the treatment of various autoimmune diseases. Celastrol, one of the primary active ingredients of T. wilfordii, was previously reported to attenuate the differentiation of Th17 cells which are closely related to the pathogenesis of autoimmune diseases, but its underlying mechanism remains to be identified. PURPOSE: This study investigated the effect of celastrol on Th17 cell response and explored the mechanism of action based on cellular metabolism. METHODS: Primary CD4(+) T cells isolated from the mesenteric lymph nodes of C57BL/6 mice were stimulated with Th17 cell differentiation conditions. The Th17 cell proportion, mRNA expression of key transcription factor and cytokines, protein level of histone deacetylases (HDACs) as well as concentration of glutamine and its metabolites were detected by flow cytometry, real-time quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR), western blot and ELISA, respectively. The transcription factor for glutaminase 1 (GLS1) was predicted by database and verified by ChIP-qPCR and luciferase reporter assay. The binding of celastrol to HDAC was simulated by molecular docking and further verified by protein thermal stability detection, microscale thermophoresis and siRNA transfection. Colitis model was established in mice using dextran sulfate sodium (DSS). RESULTS: In vitro, celastrol inhibited Th17 cell differentiation in a concentration-dependent manner. Metabolic screening revealed that celastrol preferentially downregulated glutaminolysis, as evidenced by increased intracellular glutamine levels and decreased GLS1 expression at both protein and mRNA levels. Exogenous supplement of glutamine or glutaminolysis products reversed the effect of celastrol, indicating that celastrol attenuates Th17 differentiation by inhibiting GLS1-dependent glutaminolysis. Database screening identified forkhead box 3 (FOXO3) as a key transcription factor regulating GLS1 expression. Celastrol interacted with HDAC3, reducing its activity and leading to increased acetylation and upregulation of FOXO3 expression. FOXO3, in turn, bound to the GLS1 promoter, resulting in downregulation of GLS1 expression. In mice with DSS-induced colitis, the inhibitory effect of celastrol on Th17 cell response was verified. CONCLUSION: Celastrol mitigates the Th17 cell response by downregulating HDAC3/FOXO3/GLS-dependent glutaminolysis, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic agent for Th17 cell activation-related autoimmune diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：雷公藤制剂在中国长期用于治疗多种自身免疫性疾病。雷公藤甲素（celastrol）是雷公藤的主要活性成分之一，此前报道其可减弱与自身免疫性疾病发病密切相关的Th17细胞分化，但其潜在机制尚待阐明。目的：本研究探讨了雷公藤甲素对Th17细胞反应的影响，并基于细胞代谢探索其作用机制。方法：从C57BL/6小鼠肠系膜淋巴结分离原代CD4(+) T细胞，在Th17细胞分化条件下刺激。通过流式细胞术、实时定量PCR（RT-qPCR）、蛋白质印迹和ELISA分别检测Th17细胞比例、关键转录因子和细胞因子的mRNA表达、组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDACs）的蛋白水平以及谷氨酰胺及其代谢物的浓度。谷氨酰胺酶1（GLS1）的转录因子通过数据库预测，并经ChIP-qPCR和荧光素酶报告基因实验验证。雷公藤甲素与HDAC的结合通过分子对接模拟，并进一步通过蛋白热稳定性检测、微量热泳动和siRNA转染验证。使用葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）在小鼠中建立结肠炎模型。结果：体外实验中，雷公藤甲素以浓度依赖性方式抑制Th17细胞分化。代谢筛查显示，雷公藤甲素优先下调谷氨酰胺分解，表现为细胞内谷氨酰胺水平升高，GLS1在蛋白和mRNA水平表达降低。外源性补充谷氨酰胺或谷氨酰胺分解产物可逆转雷公藤甲素的作用，表明雷公藤甲素通过抑制GLS1依赖性谷氨酰胺分解来减弱Th17分化。数据库筛查鉴定出叉头框蛋白3（FOXO3）为调控GLS1表达的关键转录因子。雷公藤甲素与HDAC3相互作用，降低其活性，导致FOXO3乙酰化增加和表达上调。FOXO3随后结合至GLS1启动子，导致GLS1表达下调。在DSS诱导的结肠炎小鼠中，雷公藤甲素对Th17细胞反应的抑制作用得到验证。结论：雷公藤甲素通过下调HDAC3/FOXO3/GLS依赖性谷氨酰胺分解来减轻Th17细胞反应，凸显其作为Th17细胞活化相关自身免疫性疾病治疗药物的潜力。
